summary: PMGC Holdings filed an 8-K reporting two investor-relations service agreements rather than any transactional event. On November 1, 2026 it engaged IR Agency LLC for marketing and media distribution beginning November 10, 2026, for up to three months at $300,000. On November 4, 2026 it signed a digital marketing agreement with Senergy Communications Capital Inc. for roughly one month, extendable by mutual consent, at C$185,000 plus taxes. Item 7.01 furnishes preclinical EL-32 semaglutide combination study results and next-phase development plans. No price, stake, premium or board recommendation; routine vendor contracts, not a special situation.
